android-data-display|Card.summary: A Plenix product card on Android is the Material 3 OutlinedCard of the Plenix card, holding one product: its picture at 1:1, the name as the card’s one TalkBack stop, the price in Reddit Mono with the old price struck through on sale, the rating, and Add to cart as its own button. Sale and Out of stock are Plenix badges with their icon. Material’s default card has no price role; Plenix keeps the card’s ripple and semantics and sets prices in the data font.

android-forms|Radio group.summary: Plenix on Android chooses a product’s size the way the web’s size buttons do: a row of selectable chips that act as one radio group, the chosen size named beside the option (“Size: M”), and a size out of stock kept in view, disabled, with its note. Material’s default for one choice from a few is a radio group or filter chips; Plenix uses chips with selectableGroup semantics so TalkBack reads them as radio buttons.

android-patterns|Step flow.summary: Plenix on Android runs checkout as a step flow, as the web’s Checkout does with the Wizard: contact, delivery, payment and review, one screen each with the step count in the top app bar, Back keeping every answer, and Place order on the review. The order summary is a bottom sheet the total opens. Payment fields use the autofill hints for cards and the number keyboard; the template collects them and hands them to the payment provider, never keeping them.
